title: POL-983: policy governing the Invoice Router
body:
Scope

This policy applies to every user of the Invoice Router and is in force.
Northwind Systems audits compliance with the controls listed here each year on
behalf of the owner, Tomas Lindqvist from Data Services.

Requirements

The requirements, last reviewed on 20 July 2025, are:
- Store secrets only in the central vault, never in source control
- Retain audit logs for at least thirteen months
- Tag every cloud resource with an owner and a cost centre

Status

Status of this policy: in force. Version issued 27 May 2025 by Samuel Adeyemi;
exceptions on file: 36, all expiring at the yearly audit.
